_description: Isolates inflationStdDev effect: zero portfolio variance, non-zero inflation stddev. Verifies that stochastic inflation creates spread in real-dollar outcomes without affecting probability.
_rationale: Same 60/40 portfolio as split-returns-blended (stocks 10%/0%, bonds 2%/0%) with 3% inflation and 2% inflation stddev. All portfolio variance is zero so all runs produce identical nominal balances. Only inflation differs across runs, creating spread in real-dollar portfolio values. No spending so probability = 100% for all runs. Median real balance should be near 500000 * 1.068^10 / 1.03^10 ≈ 718k but may vary due to log-normal inflation deflation (the geometric mean slightly exceeds the arithmetic mean).
name: Inflation StdDev Test
